name: archx-memory-retrieval-v1
description: Labelled retrieval set over Archx project knowledge: technical facts, decisions, known issues and solutions. Relevance is graded 1 (useful) to 3 (directly answers the query).

corpus.text: The user prefers metric units and ISO dates in every answer and report.
The primary database is SQLite in WAL mode with a single serialised writer thread.
Trace events live in a separate database file so tracing can never block conversation writes.

corpus.solution: write to a temporary file in the same directory, fsync, then os.replace
corpus.text: Atomic file writes are done by writing a temporary file, fsyncing it, then calling os.replace so readers never observe partial content.

corpus.solution: record an applied_writes marker in the same transaction as the data
corpus.text: Exactly-once writes use a journal row plus an applied_writes marker inserted in the same transaction as the payload, so replay cannot double-apply.

corpus.solution: serialise writes through one coordinator and use a busy timeout
corpus.text: Database is locked errors were reduced by serialising every write through one coordinator thread and setting a busy timeout of ten seconds.
Run the test suite with python -m pytest -q; the import matrix test fails when a layer imports upwards.
Windows path handling produced symlink escapes until resolve_within and child_path were applied everywhere.
Local-first is mandatory: no private conversation or memory may be sent to a remote provider without explicit opt-in.
The first prototype stored memory in JSON files and lost writes when two processes appended at once.
Version 0.1 used a single 135M parameter model with a 2048 token context window and no persistent storage.
Credentials are referenced through an environment variable name and are never stored as literal text.
Context compaction may summarise or hide messages but must never delete stored conversation history.
Reducing the embedding dimension from 1024 to 256 may improve scan speed; this has not been measured on this machine.
Six layers: interfaces, application, initialization, managers, helpers and adapters, with an enforced import matrix.
Permission grants have a duration: once, task, conversation, project or persistent, and they expire automatically.
End-to-end checks run the installed console script archx-agent against a temporary home directory.
The user prefers concise answers and asks for tables when comparing options.

corpus.solution: report pending instead of success under backpressure
corpus.text: When the write queue is full the coordinator returns a pending outcome with an error instead of claiming the write succeeded.
An early experiment used a vector database server; it was dropped because a single-file SQLite store was simpler to back up.

queries.query: how do we avoid corrupt files when the process crashes mid write
can compaction delete my chat history
is it allowed to send conversations to a cloud provider
how should units and dates be formatted
what is the embedding dimension advice
what was the original prototype storage
what happens when the write queue is full
